name: Tourist Visa / Business Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a passport valid 6+ months with an empty visa page, a completed application form, and a recent 2x2 photo.
Requires a company letter detailing the trip's purpose and a financial guarantee, plus a valid passport and application materials.

outcome.duration_length: Single or multiple entry, processed in 10+ business days (e-visa available for eligible nationalities)

sources.title: Embassy of Egypt, Washington DC -- Consular Services: tourist visa ($27/$62), business visa ($62/$87, company letter required), student visa (school registration), 10+ business day processing, e-visa portal reference

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Egypt). Fees quoted are for US passport holders specifically; the source notes fees vary by nationality. Egypt also operates an official e-visa portal (visa2egypt.gov.eg) for eligible nationalities, referenced but not independently fetched in this pass -- the tourist-visa figures here reflect the traditional consular application route. Tourist visas can reportedly be extended up to 5 years under some conditions per a separate tier-1 government real-estate portal source (see eg_investor_residence.json's notes) -- not independently confirmed at tier-1 precision for this specific file and flagged as a gap.
